document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-git.md` for the full workflow. Run `git status` and `git log --oneline -10` before acting. Never force-push or `reset --hard` without explicit user confirmation. Stage specific files rather than `git add -A`. Do not commit `.env`, credentials, or files in `.tmp/`. Follow commit message conventions visible in `git log`.
